title: Full English Breakfast
description: A traditional British breakfast consisting of sausages, eggs, bacon, and toast.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat.
2. Add the sliced bacon to the pan and cook until crispy.
3. Remove the bacon from the pan and set aside.
4. Add the sausages to the pan and cook until browned on all sides.
5. Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
6. Crack the eggs into the pan and cook until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to your liking.
7. Add the baked beans to the pan and heat through.
8. Toast the bread until it is lightly browned.
9. Assemble the full English breakfast by placing the cooked sausages, bacon, eggs, mushrooms, and baked beans onto the toasted bread.
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
